notes.title: Update Notes For June 21, 2022
notes.notes:
In case someone really reads it: the game has an update! (Wow! No way :0 )

[h1]List of changes[/h1]

[h2]Scoring system:[/h2]
Now the game will update the player's record every time the score changes, and not when summing up, as it was before. Which means now there is no need to specifically lose the game to update your record and get into the leaderboard.

[h2]Options:[/h2]
2 new items have been added to the options:
[list]
[*] Inverted camera (horizontal)
[*] Inverted camera (vertical)
[/list]
Some players complained that the game has an inverted camera by default (which is NOT true...). Now, everyone will be able to customize the camera control for themselves.

[h2]Controls:[/h2]
Added the ability to reassign control keys. Have you always dreamed of moving a piece using the R[/Mouse3 keys, instead of boring WASD? Well, I have good news for you ;)
